improvement: ● Optimized the heated bed zone heating strategy: when the center zone temperature is above 80°C, the outer zones are automatically heated to 80°C to reduce PEI plate deformation during high-temperature printing.
● Adjusted the flame sensor sensitivity to reduce false triggers.
● Added a reminder to adjust the flame sensor sensitivity.
● Optimized dual-nozzle lift status detection to reduce false alarms.

summary: V2.8.1 This update optimizes the heated bed zone heating strategy to reduce PEI plate deformation during high-temperature printing, adjusts the flame sensor sensitivity to reduce false triggers and adds a reminder to adjust it, and optimizes dual-nozzle lift status detection to reduce false alarms.
